title: language models / Use Copilot Fusion
content: ## Use Copilot Fusion Copilot Fusion chooses models and a workflow to complete your task, so you don't need to select a model for each step. For background on how Fusion differs from Auto and when to use it, see [Copilot Fusion concepts](/docs/agents/concepts/language-models.md#copilot-fusion). For details about orchestration, tiers, availability, and AI credit usage, see [Copilot model orchestration](https://docs.github.com/en/early-access/copilot/hydrafusion) in the GitHub documentation. To use Copilot Fusion: 1. Verify that `setting(chat.copilot.dynamicAutoTiers.enabled)` is enabled in the Settings editor. Changing it restarts the {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} runtime after active requests finish. 1. Start a new chat with the [Copilot harness](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#copilot). 1. In the model picker, select **Copilot Fusion**, then choose an available tier: **Standard**, **High**, or **Max**. Enabling the setting doesn't grant access to Fusion tiers. If the service doesn't offer a Fusion tier that your account can run, the picker continues to show **Auto** instead.
